subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw trust and adopt these 14 new executable GitHub Action revisions in credentialed, security, automation, and release workflows after a clean exact-head rebase?
rationale: The patch has no identified correctness defect, but accepting new third-party executable bytes in privileged workflows is a repository trust decision that automated review and ordinary green CI cannot make.

options.title: Approve after exact-head validation
options.body: Rebase the PR, confirm the immutable pins and upstream release scope, and merge after workflow-sanity, security-sensitive, and affected critical checks are green.

options.title: Split sensitive action updates
options.body: Land lower-privilege setup and analysis revisions separately while reviewing Codex, token-minting, registry-login, and release-action revisions in a narrower PR.

options.title: Pause the dependency refresh
options.body: Keep the existing pins until maintainers are comfortable with the upstream changes or the remaining exact-head checks are resolved.

recommendation.title: Approve after exact-head validation
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR, confirm the immutable pins and upstream release scope, and merge after workflow-sanity, security-sensitive, and affected critical checks are green.
